demo.heroSub: AI chatbots, smart scheduling, automatic FAQ and lead qualification in one solution. See live what AI can do for your business.
demo.chatbotDesc: Answer common questions automatically – 24/7, without waiting time. The chatbot knows your prices, opening hours and processes.
demo.appointmentDesc: Customers book their preferred appointment independently. AI recommends the optimal time slot based on availability and workload.
demo.faqDesc: An intelligent FAQ assistant filters the right answers in real time as the user types. Less support effort for you.
demo.leadDesc: A smart questionnaire determines in 4 steps how well a visitor fits as a customer. You immediately see: Hot Lead, Warm Lead or Info Lead.
demo.beforeAfterDesc: Drag the slider and see live what a modern website looks like. From outdated to professional – in one drag.
demo.analyticsDesc: A complete analytics dashboard as it runs on your website. Visitors, conversions, traffic sources – all at a glance.
demo.imageGenSubtitle: Images at the click of a button.
demo.imageGenDesc: Describe an image in words – the AI generates it. Ideal for website content, social media and marketing materials.
demo.industryDesc: Select your industry and see live what a tailored website would look like for you.
demo.statsDesc: Numbers speak for themselves. Scroll down and see our results in action.
demo.contactFormDesc: Send an inquiry and experience how our AI instantly generates a personalized response with package recommendation.
demo.faq_q1: How much does a professional website cost?
demo.faq_a1: Costs depend on scope. A landing page starts at €500, a multi-page business website from €1,000 and premium projects with custom features from €2,000. All prices are one-time – no monthly agency fees.
demo.faq_q2: How long does it take to build a website?
demo.faq_a2: A landing page can often be ready in 5–7 business days. A complete business website typically takes 1–3 weeks. The exact timeline depends on complexity and how quickly you provide content and feedback.
demo.faq_q3: What is Context Engineering and why do I need it?
demo.faq_a3: Context Engineering means equipping AI systems with the right knowledge about your business. This allows an AI chatbot on your website to explain your specific products, prices and processes – instead of giving generic answers. The result: better customer experience, less support effort.
demo.faq_q4: Can AI really help my local business?
demo.faq_a4: Absolutely! AI chatbots answer common questions 24/7, automatically qualify leads and book appointments – without you having to be present. Local businesses like doctor's offices, tradespeople or restaurants benefit enormously from these automations.
demo.faq_a5: Of course! After project completion, everything belongs to you: code, domain, hosting access. We don't deliver a rental solution but your own digital property. You can make changes yourself at any time or continue to work with us.
